blocks.text: 41 9132 120 Street Queen Mary Park Surrey Surrey V3V 4B6

parts.t: Welcome to Scott Plaza – where comfort meets convenience. This beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom manufactured home offers 854 sq. ft. of livable space plus a 61 sq. ft. porch, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee. Step inside to a bright, open-concept layout, with an inviting living area ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Located in central Surrey, you’ll enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, transit, and amenities in a friendly, pet-friendly community. Don’t miss your chance—book your private showing today!
